test.name: Walking skeleton through the CLI and GUI

expected: Instances created, started, and stopped through stackly show up in the Stackly window without a refresh, survive closing and quitting the app and a killed or stopped stacklyd with the same PID, never appear twice, and leave no fake process after stop
actual: 1-4: app opened on Overview (it reopens on the last page) with `No Instances`; footer `stacklyd degraded` (orange), not `stacklyd running`, because no catalog exists outside an app bundle (stacklyd logs catalog not_configured). 5: `created demo (01a18bf0-2d83-...)`, exit 0; with no click a `demo` row appeared, `fake 0.1.0 · auto`, Stopped. 6: `start --wait` exit 0 after 3 s (`demo running, readiness ready`); the capture at about 0.7 s showed the row `Not Ready · status 503`, a Needs Attention item `demo isn't ready`, and an operation card `Start demo · Running · Readiness`, and from about 2 s the row read Running with `:57746`; a separate Starting state was shorter than the 0.35 s sampling and was not captured; `instance get`: Lifecycle running, Readiness ready, pid 93647; ps showed exactly one `stackly-fake-server serve` with pid 93647. 7: close button: toast `Stackly is still running / Closing the window doesn't stop stacklyd or your instances. Click Stackly in the Dock to reopen it.`; app process alive; pid 93647 unchanged in get and ps; Dock click brought the window back with `demo` Running. 8: Quit Stackly: app exited; get still running, pid 93647; relaunch showed `demo` Running with no refresh. 9: SIGINT stacklyd: it exited; the window showed the banner `STACKLY_ROOT is set. Showing the last known state from 15.33. ...` with Reconnect and Open Diagnostics (the STACKLY_ROOT variant of the offline banner, not the text `Can't connect to stacklyd.`), footer `stacklyd unavailable`, the `demo` row kept as Running with Stop disabled, the fake process alive; after starting stacklyd again the banner was gone and get showed pid 93647 `adopted`. 10: SIGKILL stacklyd and start again: pid 93647 `adopted`, exactly one `serve` process, `1 instance: 1 running`, exactly one `demo` row. 11: failInit create: exit 7, `operation ... failed`, `code: supervisor.init_failed`; since spec 0020 step 9 the init failure is fully compensated, so the operation ends `failed`, not `needs_recovery`, no `broken` row appears at any time (list stays `1 instance`), and `operation abandon` answers `operation.not_abandonable` exit 3. 12: the init helper appeared about 0.3 s after the create (pid 95786); SIGKILL of stacklyd and restart: exactly one `slow` row, Failed with `Initialization failed. Remove this instance and create it again.`, Needs Attention `Create slow needs recovery` and `slow failed`; `operation inspect` State needs_recovery, Recovery `abandon after compensation_failed`; the init helper was gone on its own about 13 s after the create; `operation abandon --yes` printed `abandoned operation ... (state failed)` and `No leftovers.`, and the `slow` row went away. 13: `stop --wait` exit 0 (`demo stopped`); with no click the row became Stopped; get Lifecycle stopped, Process -; no stackly-fake-server process under the root. D: locked keychain start exit 6 `secret.needs_secret` naming `local:instance/<id>/auth-token reason=store_locked`, no dialog from Stackly seen in the captures, get `Blocker needs secret: ... (store_locked)`, the row stayed Stopped with Needs Attention `demo needs a secret`; after restarting stacklyd the start succeeded (exit 0, ready, Blocker -) and the row became Running; the capture 1 s after the CLI finished still showed Stopped with the card `Start demo · Validate`, and the next capture at 15:35:22 showed Running (follow-up the same day on the same frozen binaries, window sampled every 0.3 s: three restart-then-start trials, with the window behind other apps, in front, and after a start refused by the locked keychain, showed the row Running 0.03 to 0.31 s after `start --wait` returned, so the 1 s lag did not reproduce; no frame in any trial showed a separate Starting label, the row goes Stopped, `Not Ready · status 503`, Running; strips in target/evidence-0014/lag-trials/). Cleanup: no process from the run left, root and runtime folder removed. Not covered: spec step 11 (screen reader reading of rows), removed with the interaction policy change of 2026-10-24.
steps: run on 2026-10-30 on commit 5c074e02 (the code of f9fbc4c8; 5c074e02 only changes docs/scope/ui-macos.md), not on c4c7e3e where this record was made; host as in context

builds: `cargo build -p stacklyd -p stackly-cli -p stackly-fake-server`, `cargo build -p stacklyd --example skeleton_seed`, `cargo xtask build-app` (the Debug app now lands at target/app/Debug/Stackly.app, not target/xcode/...); then stacklyd, stackly, stackly-fake-server, skeleton_seed, and Stackly.app were copied to a private folder and run from there with SHA-256 noted (stacklyd 8948d19d..., stackly e4a88e74..., stackly-fake-server d17d9fc1..., skeleton_seed 4aea4b1d...), because a first attempt the same day was spoiled from step 12 on when another session rebuilt target/debug/stacklyd mid run: the file keychain ACL trusts the ad hoc cdhash, so the replaced binary got access_denied and secret.needs_secret; that attempt was discarded and every step below is from the second, frozen run

Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) drove the app through the macOS accessibility API (the window's close button, the Dock item, and the Stackly > Quit Stackly menu item) and captured only the Stackly window with `screencapture -l <window id>`; CLI with STACKLY_ROOT set; ps scoped to the root path; daemon stops were SIGINT (as Ctrl+C) and SIGKILL to that run's own stacklyd PID only, never `pkill`/`pgrep -f`, because the user's own stacklyd (another PID) was running
seed a fresh `mktemp -d /tmp/stk-skel.XXXXXX` root with `skeleton_seed --root "$R" --fake-server <copy>`, start stacklyd, open the app on the same root

steps 5 to 13 of section C in docs/manual.md (create demo with readyDelayMs=3000, start, close window, Dock, quit and relaunch, SIGINT and SIGKILL of stacklyd, failInit create, interrupted slow create with initDelayMs=20000 killed 0.3 s after the init helper appeared, stop), with a window capture after each

section D right after (lock the root file keychain with `security lock-keychain`, start with stdin from /dev/null, restart stacklyd, start again), then clean up: stop demo, quit the app, SIGINT stacklyd, ps check, remove the root and its runtime folder
reviewer: ojiepermana, reviewing the captures and logs Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) took while it drove the app (target/evidence-0014/), accepted as AC-16 reviewer on 2026-10-30
